create.action: Create a new object or being using tags.

inflict.description: Inflict a status on a target.

Settings.auto_mark_improve_hint: Automatically mark Improve on the owning theme when a weakness or relationship tag is invoked in a roll. When disabled, the roll's chat card offers a Mark Improve button instead.
Settings.colorblind_mode_hint: Replace the tag, weakness, status, and limit chip colors with a palette tuned for deuteranopia, protanopia, and tritanopia. Applies to both light and dark themes.
Settings.content_sources_gm_only: Only Gamemasters can see this compendium, so it cannot be used as a content source — players would never see its content. Change the compendium's ownership to make it available.
Settings.content_sources_hint: Configure which sources are used for browsing themebooks, themekits, tropes, and statuses.
Settings.content_sources_trusted_only: The compendium's ownership hides it from regular players — only Trusted players and Gamemasters will see content from this source.
Settings.content_sources_no_filter: No packs selected — all available compendium packs will be searched.
Settings.content_sources_no_filter_world: No sources selected — all compendium packs and world items are included.
Settings.content_sources_reset_confirm: This will delete all statuses in the world pack and re-populate with defaults. Continue?
Settings.custom_dice_hint: Use the custom Legend in the Mist dice visuals instead of standard d6s. Requires the Dice So Nice module.
Settings.hero_limit_hint: The status tier at which a hero is overcome; a status one tier higher is permanent, meaning death or transformation. The core book default is 5, and lowering it makes for a grittier campaign. Raising it above 5 is homebrew: status tracks throughout the world deepen to match, so every character and challenge can take statuses one tier past the hero limit.
Settings.improve_threshold_hint: Number of Improve marks needed before a theme can choose an advancement. The default of 3 follows the core book; raise it to slow down progression.
Settings.popout_tags_sidebar_hint: Automatically open the Tags sidebar in a pop-out window on load.
Settings.show_camping_threats_hint: Display the Threats section on the camping/sojourn scene. Disable if your table relies on challenge profiles or journals instead.
Settings.theme_limit_hint: Maximum number of themes a hero can have. The default of 4 follows the core book; raise to allow more thematic breadth per hero.
Settings.use_fellowship_hint: Enable the shared Fellowship actor, fellowship themes, and relationship tags. Disable for solo play or games without a fellowship. Requires reload.
